title: Shanghai Institute of Ceramics, Chinese Academy of Sciences
content: Aerogel Research Institute. The Shanghai Institute of Ceramics, Chinese Academy of Sciences, specializes in ceramics, inorganic materials, and advanced materials engineering. Its official profiles reference aerogel process development and high-temperature insulation applications, making it relevant for aerogel research, scale-up, and technical support.
